subject: Quick intro — VC ops background

subject: Application follow-up — Tuck T'22
body:
Hi Jack,

I applied to the PM role at GlobalTech last week and wanted to introduce myself directly. Three reasons I'm excited about this specific role:

1. The product scope aligns with my VC ops work at Dartmouth
2. GlobalTech's stage-gate process mirrors what I built at my last role
3. I'm a Tuck T'22 alum and have heard great things from the network

Happy to share more — is a quick call possible?

Kishore
